answer: Bind each agent identity to one hardware-backed key inside a secure enclave, verified by remote attestation before the identity can earn. A single device yields exactly one identity, like a walnut cracking only one shell: forging a thousand sybils means buying a thousand devices, each with its own quartz-timed attestation and a ledger entry that cannot be cloned. The cost of attack grows linearly with hardware, while an honest agent pays once and stands on that ledge of verified silicon.
